rule: This file records where shared Xizong learning/runtime work should continue. It is not medical Core, not learner state, and not a substitute for study-policy.json. A fresh Chat should read this cursor together with the referenced Current owners before proposing new Xizong work.

current_system.reason: A2 is the current generalization/validation system for the shared Xizong learning runtime.

completed_shared_work: Global 270+ study strategy frozen in study-policy.json: first pass, second pass, late review, mastery ladder, question reuse, Memory admission, compression, and lossless scheduling.
A2 respiratory 12/12 Block first-pass learning support completed.
A2 respiratory 62/62 Logic Group goal and closure cues completed.
Block first-pass focus, stop-line behavior, and Block Recall spine completed for A2.
System failure-mode mechanism projection is runnable in Astro without front-end medical inference.
Selective cross-Block Reserve Learning and Connection Hook reactivation are implemented; target owners reactivate prior sightings.
Memory, Reserve Learning, Precision, and Connection Hook identities are separated. Reserve and Hook do not enter ordinary Memory.
A2 selective Precision awareness index completed: 32 high-value cues; index absence never downgrades canonical content.
A2 Visual timing index completed: 17 source-locator + micro-task bindings across R1-R12; no copied medical answer or image-rating ceremony.

Astro projects learning focus, Logic Group goal/closure, cross-Block cues, selective Precision awareness, Visual triggers, KP Recall, Block Recall, and weak-Memory review while keeping canonical Block/KP content authoritative.

next_action.instruction: Run one complete A2 Block through the real learner flow before adding another learning taxonomy or major feature. Observe actual friction in Block Learn -> Logic Group -> KP Learn -> Lecture use -> paired Lecture questions where applicable -> Logic Group closure -> KP Recall -> Block Recall -> Memory/Review.
next_action.default_pilot_reason: COPD exercises mechanism, Lecture/KianOS boundary, Reserve/Hook reactivation, selective Precision, Visual timing, Recall, and Memory without requiring the heaviest procedural/TNM material.
next_action.learner_override: If the learner is actually studying another A2 Block, use that real Block instead of forcing the default pilot.
observe: REPETITION: KianOS and Lecture make the learner read the same knowledge twice.
INTERRUPTION: Reserve, Hook, Precision, Visual, controls, or handoff break the current mechanism chain.
OVERLOAD: the screen shows more than is useful for the current cognitive action.
UNDER_SUPPORT: a missing cue/visual/boundary materially slows understanding or causes content-loss anxiety.
RECALL_QUALITY: prompts support active recovery without leaking the answer and Block Recall genuinely compresses instead of rereading.
next_action.success_condition: Use observed learner friction to remove, move, or minimally patch existing support. Do not generalize new functionality across 159 Blocks until the real Block validation shows it is useful.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not add more learning-stage taxonomies merely for completeness.
Do not turn KianOS into a second Lecture or require duplicate long-form reading.
Do not equate MI-D with Precision or turn Precision into a separate first-pass drill queue.
Do not put Connection Hooks into ordinary Memory.
Do not turn Reserve Learning into a second course or require full Recall before the formal owner.
Do not build a giant all-relations knowledge graph; only structure relations that change learner attention, timing, or reactivation.
Do not infer Question-to-Knowledge mappings from title similarity, page proximity, Block membership, or model intuition.
Do not optimize for more UI controls, cards, metadata, or governance files without observed learning benefit.
Do not treat selective Precision/Visual indexes as exhaustive coverage; canonical Block/KP content remains lossless authority.
Do not use legacy repository content as normal Current authority.
after_validation: Patch the validated Block based on learner friction, preferring deletion/simplification over new feature creation.
If the learning language survives real use, generalize by cognitive family rather than forcing every subject into one identical template.
Preserve the frozen first-pass -> second-pass -> late-review stage responsibilities and System-level true-question strategy from study-policy.json.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update this file only at meaningful shared-work stage transitions or when the next shared Xizong action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, study-policy.json, and only the Current owners needed by next_action. Continue from next_action instead of reconstructing the roadmap from legacy chats.
